summary: Umatilla NF lookout: 1941 L-4 on a pole tower, 1959 67-foot R-6 tower; unmanned today; gated access road; NHLR-registered 2004.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on 67-foot treated timber tower

access.note: Cheryl Hill directory lists it as accessible to the public. A gate on Road 271 may be closed and locked; the catwalk was locked at an October 2021 visit.

visit.trail_note: Gate on Road 271 may be closed and locked; if so, park and walk about one mile up the road to the tower.

corrections.why: 7.3 m matches no source read. The Register, firelookout.com and Cheryl Hill's 2021 write-up give a 67-foot tower, about 20.4 m.

corrections.proposed: 1941 built as 24-foot L-4 pole tower; 1959 present R-6 tower built (Forest files delayed it to 1960)
corrections.why: The record lists only 1959, which covers the present tower. The site's first lookout dates to 1941, and the Forest's own files say the replacement was delayed to 1960.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register, firelookout.com and the history page give a 24-foot pole tower for 1941. Cheryl Hill's 2021 write-up says 40 feet. The story reports both.

The Register, firelookout.com and Cheryl Hill's 2021 write-up give 67 feet. A 1963 USGS survey note on the history page says 100 feet. The story gives 67 feet and reports the survey figure. height_m uses 67 feet.
The Register and firelookout.com date the present tower to 1959. Forest files on the history page planned it for 1959 and then said it was delayed to 1960. The story reports both.
The Register gives 5,277 ft (1,608 m), matching the record. firelookout.com and the directory give 5,303 ft. The record is kept at the Register figure for editor review.

firelookout.com says it is staffed in summer, and the Register says it is now in active service. The 2026 directory lists it as unmanned, and the 2021 and 2005 visits found no staff. The story uses the July 2026 directory for current staffing.

notes_for_editor: Original and present tower heights, the 1959 vs 1960 replacement date, and the 100 ft USGS survey figure all conflict across sources; reported in the story. The directory's staffing status is as of July 2026. Lookout staff names listed on firelookout.com were left out of the story. No photos added; the Register and firelookout.com credit photos to the Umatilla NF and a private collection, and were not checked for licensing. The NHLR page also has 2003 and 2005 visit reports and a 2016 photo gallery that were not read.
